Build with Ayomide is operated by Olajide Oladapo Ayomide. Contact: daotechnology18@gmail.com.

Contact forms

The forms prepare a WhatsApp message or email draft. They do not submit your details to a website database. Your message is only sent when you complete sending in WhatsApp or your email app. Those services handle it under their own privacy practices. Information you send is used to respond to your inquiry and discuss the project.

Campaign measurement

Campaign tags in the page URL may be included in the message you choose to send. Contact clicks can create in-page measurement events. These indicate contact intent, not proof that a message was delivered or that you became a client.

Optional Meta Pixel measurement is disabled unless configured. If configured, it asks for permission before loading. If you allow it, Meta may receive page visits, contact-intent events, and standard browser/network information. We do not include your form fields or message in our custom measurement events. Marketing permission is remembered in your browser and Do Not Track is respected.

Offline features

The PWA stores site files and viewed images in your browser for offline access. It does not save your form answers. Hosting services may process ordinary request logs to deliver and secure the site.
